text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm taking a stroll through
the
streets...

text_block_list.name: Figure in Black A
text_block_list.text: ...Over here. Hurry.

text_block_list.name: Woman in Tuxedo
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gentlemen! I cordially
welcome you to
our casino tournament!
The stakes—nothing but
your dignity as
a high roller! Compete to your
heart's
content, for today and today only! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for cryin' out loud. I thought I saw a
fish outta
water, and here you are again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Before you get any funny ideas, this
tournament
is completely legit, all right?
Despite the
unregistered busybodies
stickin' their noses in.

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Pssst! Look, it's her...
The legendary
dealer—the Angel of the Night!
Oh, I
can't believe I get to see her in person!

text_block_list.name: Angel of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. Who do we have here? Hehe.
Long time
no see.
choice_data_list: 天使様って、前に河川敷にいた……？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Well, well, well. Looks like Your Holiness is pretty popular.

text_block_list.name: Angel of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, and I've chosen you as my
opponent.
What do you say? Care to put
your pride on the
line?

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: No way! An opponent handpicked by the Angel herself? Who is that? Snicker. Nobody beats the Angel...

text_block_list.name: Angel of the Night
text_block_list.text:
The name of the game is roulette. You
lay down
your chips, and I'll spin the
wheel. We'll decide
this with a single
round, nice and simple.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't suppose there's any issue with
betting on a
color rather than a number?

text_block_list.name: Angel of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Take your pick, black or red.

All right, time to spin the wheel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Angel throws the white roulette ball
onto the
spinning wheel. It makes a
strangely satisfying
sound as it rolls, and
the throng of bystanders
watch with
sweaty palms and bated breath.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember when we talked about
habits?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Competition sets your body into a

combative state, no matter who you're
facing.
That's why habits develop
without one's
knowledge.
choice_data_list: 確か、スペシャルウィークの……

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
For example, when the Angel here's
aimin' for a
specific pocket, she has a
habit of rollin' the ball
to a certain
rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It helps that a dealer as well-known as
she has an
extensive amount of material
to study.
choice_data_list: そんなことが本当にわかるのか？
そんなことが本当にわかるの？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Plus, as someone who lives and breathes
the
races, I've developed an internal
clock to count
my laps. If I combine that
with what I know about
the Angel's
habits...

text_block_list.name: Angel of the Night
text_block_list.text: Th-that's enough! Let's start over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The game comes to a sudden halt. They
decide to
resume the match after a short
breather.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Are you worried that you might've
ruined my
plan? Haha... Not to worry.
choice_data_list: あの時、俺が話しかけなければ……
あの時、私が話しかけなければ……

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I was just bluffing when I said all that
stuff about
her habits.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And did you see how flustered she
looked? It
paid off in spades. With this,
she now knows that
underhanded tricks
won't work.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this. No more tricks,
just a bona
fide test of luck.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I bet on black. Who wants to bet on
the Angel
goin' down?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, the Angel of the Night
quickly
proclaims that bets are closed.
Soon after, the
white roulette ball goes
rolling and rolling, until...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd goes wild. The ball has
landed in a
black pocket. Which means...
Nakayama Festa
has won.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the real commotion comes after the
game,
when everyone realizes that she
has disappeared
from the premises
without playing anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Days later, I spot Nakayama Festa at the

academy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you. Sorry to leave you in the
thick of it
the other day, but ya can't
blame anyone for
wantin' to get away
from all that commotion.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't after fame, after all. I just
wanted a
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice there's a bus parked up ahead of
her.
Come to think of it, the morning
news said that
she's racing today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, so you've heard. Well...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, black or white. Which do ya wanna
bet on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Yeah, me too. All right, see ya
around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that she can overtake
any racer
and claim victory today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, black or white. Which do ya wanna
bet on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself to answer. It's
normal to
waffle.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'd bet on white, though. No matter who
my
opponent is, I'll overtake them. See
ya around.
